Owners commonly consider **design-forward / distinctive-character lifestyle brands** such as **W Hotels, EDITION, Moxy, Marriott’s Design Hotels, Autograph Collection, Tribute Portfolio, Kimpton, Hotel Indigo, Canopy by Hilton, Curio Collection, Tapestry Collection, MGallery, Emblems, Mama Shelter, The Hoxton, SLS, Mondrian, Delano, 25hours, and Andaz**. These brands are repeatedly described as lifestyle or lifestyle-adjacent because they emphasize **design, local character, social spaces, food-and-beverage, and experiential positioning** rather than standard full-service uniformity.[1][5][6][7][8][10][11][18][19]

A practical way to group the most commonly considered brands is:

| Brand / collection | Parent / operator | Typical positioning |
|---|---|---|
| **W Hotels** | Marriott | Iconic luxury lifestyle; design-led and experience-heavy[10][16] |
| **EDITION** | Marriott | Luxury lifestyle with a strong design and individuality focus[11][16] |
| **Moxy Hotels** | Marriott | Chic, modern, edgy lifestyle at a more accessible price point[7][16] |
| **Design Hotels** | Marriott | Stronger design/luxury lifestyle orientation[1] |
| **Autograph Collection** | Marriott | Distinctive independent-style soft brand / collection[1] |
| **Tribute Portfolio** | Marriott | Upper-upscale lifestyle / soft-brand collection[1] |
| **Kimpton** | IHG | Design-forward, boutique lifestyle[1][6] |
| **Hotel Indigo** | IHG | Local-culture, neighborhood-driven lifestyle[2][6][13] |
| **Canopy by Hilton** | Hilton | Upscale, locally inspired boutique lifestyle[1][8][18] |
| **Curio Collection** | Hilton | Upscale lifestyle collection, often higher-end than Tapestry[1] |
| **Tapestry Collection** | Hilton | Upscale lifestyle collection with more flexible, independent character[1] |
| **MGallery** | Accor | Upscale to luxury lifestyle with distinct identity[1][9][14] |
| **Emblems Collection** | Accor | Luxury lifestyle, clearly positioned at the luxury tier[1][9] |
| **Mama Shelter** | Accor / Ennismore | Playful, social, design-led lifestyle[1][5][6] |
| **The Hoxton** | Ennismore | Stylish, social, local-experience-led lifestyle[4][5][6] |
| **SLS / Mondrian / Delano / 25hours / Hyde** | Ennismore / Accor ecosystem | Strong personality, fashion-forward or culture-forward lifestyle[5][6][7] |
| **Andaz** | Hyatt | Design-conscious, locally rooted lifestyle[11][15] |
| **Hyatt Centric** | Hyatt | Local-edge, urban lifestyle positioning[8][12] |
| **Renaissance** | Marriott | Lifestyle-oriented full-service brand[16] |

The brands most often cited in industry discussions of this segment are **W, EDITION, Kimpton, Hotel Indigo, Canopy, Moxy, Curio, Autograph, MGallery, The Hoxton, Mama Shelter, SLS, Mondrian, Delano, 25hours, and Andaz**.[1][4][6][7][10][11][15][18][19]
